dedupe_keys.name: actual total cost reduction of commercial cfd modelling tools for wind resource assessment in complex terrain

description: Sarah Barber and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The completed Stotten application compares automated wind-flow workflows using Fluent and CFX. The source reports approximately twelvefold and sevenfold reductions in actual total cost under its stated comparisons, with similar deviations for the assessed results. These cost reductions concern the particular site, workflow and baseline configuration. The case supports appraisal of computational effort and flow-model output in a real wind-resource setting. It does not establish equivalent cost reductions for every mesh, terrain or solver setup. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
